en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural, hilly landscape with meadows and scattered trees. In the middle distance stand several large villa‑style houses and farm buildings along a winding road, surrounded by fields, fenced plots and forested hills. One building has a small tower or turret. The foreground shows a flower‑covered meadow sloping down toward the settlement. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
